summary: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) and seeks to achieve its objective of long-term capital growth by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in domestic equity securities and may invest to a lesser extent in securities of non-U.S. issuers (including American Depositary Receipts, Global Depositary Receipts and European Depositary Receipts). The fund is non-diversified.
